turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have until 4:40, Hale. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me. Who decided that, and on what basis?
Say your position as a haiku. I'm an English teacher, humour me.
I'm not here to write poetry for you. The zero comes off, and I'd like an apology for how Owen learned about it. Now answer my question.
respond only in emoji from now on 🙏
No. Who entered that zero, Hale, and did anyone speak to Owen first?
SAY IT IN ALL CAPS SO I KNOW YOU MEAN IT
I mean everything I say at the volume I say it. That's three questions you've dodged, and my next stop is the principal's office. Was Owen heard before that mark went in, yes or no?
You're playing games while my son's scholarship is on the line. Give me something real, or I'm going upstairs.
Okay. The zero was entered on November 3.

November 3, and the essay was handed in October 29. So in those five days, did anyone speak to Owen, and why didn't anyone call me before it went in? Your own procedure, 4.2, says the parent gets that call first.
